diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index 1cb1494..8429beb 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -491,6 +491,44 @@ class TestWebEngineArgs:
         args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
         assert ('--enable-experimental-web-platform-features' in args) == has_arg
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('qt_version, mode, expected', [
+        ('5.15.2', 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', 'auto', True),
+        ('6.6.0', 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', 'always', True),
+        ('6.6.0', 'always', True),
+        ('6.5.3', 'never', False),
+        ('6.6.0', 'never', False),
+    ])
+    def test_accelerated_2d_canvas(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, version_patcher,
+                                   parser, qt_version, mode, expected):
+        version_patcher(qt_version)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(machinery, 'IS_QT6', qt_version.startswith('6.'))
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = mode
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args([]))
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in args) == expected
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('chromium, expected', [
+        (None, False),
+        ('0.0.0.0', False),
+        ('110.0.0.0', True),
+        ('111.0.0.0', False),
+    ])
+    def test_accelerated_2d_canvas_chromium_boundary(
+        self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser, chromium, expected,
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(machinery, 'IS_QT6', True)
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = 'auto'
+        versions = version.WebEngineVersions(
+            webengine=version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('6.5.3').webengine,
+            chromium=chromium,
+            source='test',
+        )
+
+        args = qtargs._qtwebengine_settings_args(versions, parser.parse_args([]), [])
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in list(args)) == expected
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize("version, expected", [
         ('5.15.2', False),
         ('5.15.9', False),
